name: Name the company
tagline: Name candidates scored on domains, handles, and marks — the domain bought, the logo and palette set, the trademark filed.

name: Company launch
tagline: Incorporate, get the EIN, put the founders and cap table on paper, open the bank account, turn on payroll and the books.

name: Raise a seed round
tagline: Data room standing, SAFEs signed, wires verified, cap table made true.

name: Ship v1
tagline: Repo up and agent-ready, cloud and CI/CD wired, errors and analytics watched from the first deploy.

name: Launch the website
tagline: Domain checked and bought, site generated, DNS wired, analytics on.

name: Launch on Product Hunt
tagline: Analytics and email capture on before launch day, assets ready, submitted to PH and the directories, the spike caught.

name: Get the first 10 customers
tagline: CRM up, outbound out, calls qualified, the first invoices sent.

name: Get paid
tagline: Connect payments, stand up subscriptions, send the invoice, reconcile the payout.

name: First hire
tagline: Offer out and signed, IP assigned, accounts provisioned, the first payroll run.

name: Month-end close
tagline: Vendors paid, the books reconciled and closed, the runway known, the board updated.

name: Tax season
tagline: 1099s out in January, Delaware franchise tax by March 1, the R&D credit claimed, the 1120 filed.

name: Set up compliance (SOC 2-lite)
tagline: Password manager, SSO, devices under management, privacy policy and DPA, then the SOC 2 Type I run.

name: Land the enterprise deal
tagline: Type II and the pen test in hand, status page live, NDA signed, the questionnaire cleared, the contract closed.

name: Raise the follow-on round
tagline: Cap table audited, data room fresh, the priced round closed, SAFEs converted, the 409A refreshed.
